title: MuSS: A Large-Scale Dataset and Cinematic Narrative Benchmark for Multi-Shot Subject-to-Video Generation
abstract: While video foundation models excel at single-shot generation, real-world cinematic storytelling inherently relies on complex multi-shot sequencing. Further progress is constrained by the absence of datasets that address three core challenges: authentic narrative logic, spatiotemporal text-video alignment conflicts, and the "copy-paste" dilemma prevalent in Subject-to-Video (S2V) generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce MuSS, a large-scale, dual-track dataset tailored for multi-shot video and S2V generation. Sourced from over 3,000 movies, MuSS explicitly supports both complex montage transitions and subject-centric narratives. To construct this dataset, we pioneer a progressive captioning pipeline that eliminates contextual conflicts by ensuring local shot-level accuracy before enforcing global narrative coherence. Crucially, we implement a cross-shot matching mechanism to fundamentally eradicate the S2V copy-paste shortcut. Alongside the dataset, we propose the Cinematic Narrative Benchmark, featuring a visual-logic-driven paradigm and a novel Anti-Copy-Paste Variance (ACP-Var) metric to rigorously assess continuous storytelling and 3D structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current baselines struggle with continuous narrative logic or degenerate into trivial 2D sticker generators, our MuSS-augmented model achieves state-of-the-art narrative effectiveness and cross-shot identity preservation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2604.23789v3 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 available（https://github.com/zhang-haojie/MuSS）。
analysis.ideaZh: MuSS 从 3,000+ 电影构造 10 万级 720P 多镜头片段的双轨数据：complex narrative 保留剪辑逻辑，subject-centric track 用跨镜头 reference 打破 copy-paste。Cinematic Narrative Benchmark 分别评估 local shot alignment、跨镜头结构与身份新视角一致性；作者报告 MuSS-augmented baseline 在多维叙事指标上领先，但版权、自动 caption/filter 与 benchmark 同源偏差必须重视。
methodFlow: 从 3,000+ 电影切分并筛选连续多镜头片段
progressive captioning 解析跨镜头实体与叙事
构建 complex-narrative 与 subject-centric 双轨
从独立镜头抽 reference 避免姿态复制
用双轨 benchmark 训练/评估多镜头生成
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接推进 multi-shot video generation 的数据、叙事 benchmark 和 subject consistency。
analysis.evidenceZh: MuSS 双轨管线分别处理复杂叙事与 subject-centric novel-view consistency。（Sec. 3 and Fig. 1, pp. 1, 4）；数据来自 3,000+ 电影并形成大规模 720P multi-shot clips。（Table 1, p. 4）；作者报告 MuSS-augmented baseline 在 Track 1 的 alignment、scene/casting/action/spatial logic 上整体领先比较方法。（Table 2, p. 7）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：电影域数据带来版权、地域与叙事风格偏差。；作者限制：自动 captioning/filtering 可能产生跨镜头身份与事件错误。；审阅风险：同源 benchmark 上领先不等于开放世界 prompt 的泛化。；审阅风险：身份一致性与电影主体隐私/肖像风险需单独治理。
analysis.motivationZh: 数据管线用 progressive captioning 消解跨镜头指代，按主角过滤 subject-centric sequences，并从不同镜头抽 reference 强迫 novel-view synthesis。评测双轨覆盖 narrative effectiveness 与 subject consistency。
analysis.methodZh: 数据管线用 progressive captioning 消解跨镜头指代，按主角过滤 subject-centric sequences，并从不同镜头抽 reference 强迫 novel-view synthesis。评测双轨覆盖 narrative effectiveness 与 subject consistency。 将真实 cinematic editing logic、local prompt conflict 与 cross-shot subject novel view 同时纳入大规模数据和 benchmark，比拼接单镜头数据更贴近叙事生成。
analysis.experimentsZh: 以 dual-track Cinematic Narrative Benchmark 比较 StoryDiff/I2V 等方法和 MuSS-augmented baseline，指标含 text alignment、transition deviation、scene/casting/action/spatial logic、consistency gap 与 subject metrics。 作者报告：作者报告 MuSS-augmented baseline 在 Track 1 多维 visual-logic 指标中总体最优。（Table 2, p. 7） Baseline boundary：覆盖 multi-shot 与 subject-to-video baselines；评测模型、caption pipeline 与训练数据同源可能产生偏向。 Ablation boundary：有 narrative/subject tracks、cross-shot matching 和数据增强比较；需要去除自动 caption、不同电影域与人工盲评的更强消融。
analysis.insightZh: 将真实 cinematic editing logic、local prompt conflict 与 cross-shot subject novel view 同时纳入大规模数据和 benchmark，比拼接单镜头数据更贴近叙事生成。 数据/评测基础设施与视频生成方向高度相关，值得精读；必须连同版权和同源评估 caveat 收录。
